1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Witsemba.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi yitwa Mikitamu, yahimbye ubwo yari mu buvumo ahunze Sawuli.

2.text: Mana, mbabarira mbabarira,Kuko ubugingo bwanjye buguhungiraho.Ni koko mu gicucu cy'amababa yawe ni ho ngiye guhungira,Kugeza aho ibi byago bizashirira.

4.text: Izatuma iri mu ijuru inkize,Ubwo ūshaka kumira azantuka,Sela.Imana izohereza imbabazi zayo n'umurava wayo.

5.text: Ubugingo bwanjye buri hagati y'intare,Ndyama hagati y'abaka umuriro.Abo bantu amenyo yabo ni amacumu n'imyambi,Ururimi rwabo ni inkota ityaye.

6.text: Mana, wishyire hejuru y'ijuru,Icyubahiro cyawe kibe hejuru y'isi yose.

7.text: Bateze ibirenge byanjye ikigoyi,Umutima wanjye wiyunamiriye.Bacukuye ubushya imbere yanjye,Babugwamo ubwabo.Sela.

8.text: Mana, umutima wanjye urakomeye,Umutima wanjye urakomeye,Ndaririmba, ni koko ndaririmba ishimwe.

9.text: Wa bwiza bwanjye we, kanguka,Nebelu n'inanga nimukanguke,Nanjye ubwanjye nzakanguka mbere y'umuseke.

10.text: Mwami, nzagushimira mu moko,Nzakuririmbirira ishimwe mu mahanga,

11.text: Kuko imbabazi zawe ari ndende zigera no mu ijuru,Umurava wawe ugera mu bicu.

12.text: Mana, wishyire hejuru y'ijuru,Icyubahiro cyawe kibe hejuru y'isi yose.
